description: Generated illustrations, not medically reviewed. 25 files with true alpha (no baked background), recoloured to the DR-001 illustration rule (design-tokens.md section 7). Trimmed from the WP 3.5 batch manifest and extended in D-WP-7; only accepted files are in the repository.

licensing.statement: Generated through a Magnific Plus account with Google Nano Banana 2.1. The provider's commercial-use and redistribution terms were not read or checked, so no licensing claim is made.

exerciseFallbacks: Exercises without their own picture show the picture for their body area (area-<body area>.webp). After D-WP-7 these are chin-tuck, neck-rotation and scapular-squeeze (ruled in WP 3.5) and any exercise outside the 12 in the demo persona plans.

credits.note: WP 3.5 spent 1500 against its 1500 ceiling. D-WP-7 spent 350 against its own 600 ceiling: seven generations (six first passes and one retry of towel-reach-behind). Part 1 recolour used no credits.
